explication: Twenty is an open-source, extensible CRM. A typical user works with workspace records and views in the CRM, while the server provides application and data services; developers can define app objects, views, agents, and logic functions as code and publish them to a workspace. The repository also includes a desktop call-recording companion and example apps. The README documents the product capabilities, but the sampled source does not establish most frontend-to-server or server-to-storage call paths, so those links are omitted rather than inferred.
